'''''Aerides lawrenceae''''' is a species of [[plant]] in the family [[Orchidaceae]]. It is [[Endemism|endemic]] to the [[Philippines]].<ref>[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=4097 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref>  Its natural [[habitat]] is subtropical or tropical moist lowland [[forest]]s. It is threatened by [[habitat loss]] and overcollection.<ref name=iucn>{{cite iucn |author=Agoo, E.M.G. |author2=Cootes, J. |author3=Golamco, A. |author4=Jr. |author5=de Vogel, E.F. |author6=Tiu, D. |date=2004 |title=''Aerides lawrenciae'' |volume=2004 |article-number=e.T46292A11042653 |doi=10.2305/IUCN.UK.2004.RLTS.T46292A11042653.en |access-date=15 November 2021}}</ref>

==Description==
Growing in brightly lit environments at low elevations on the islands of [[Mindanao]] and [[Cebu]], ''Aerides lawrenciae'' is a robust species up to 5 ft (1.5 meters) tall. It sometimes becomes pendulous. The inflorescence has up to 30 strongly fragrant flowers, each about 4 cm across. Flowering occurs during autumn.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20130131055752/http://www.orchidiana.com/aerides-lawrenceae.html|title=Orchidiana}}</ref><ref>Orchids, H.F. Ulmann, Botanica's Pocket, {{ISBN|978-3-8331-2935-3}}, 2007. Printed in China.</ref>
